description: This collection supplies French organic-fertiliser composition and associated source treatment inventories. CIRAD publishes an updated Excel workbook from ACV-MAFOR containing nutrients, trace elements and agronomic indicators; its repository explicitly links the preliminary Data in Brief compilation. Version 2 dates to August 2020, despite a later harvest date in the rejected candidate. Coverage primarily represents France during 2010–2020, with some European evidence and compilation during 2018–2019. The public CIRAD workbook is free under CC0 1.0. The original DOCX supplement remains linked for treatment inventory tables, but its separate licence is unknown. Mean compositions, mixed literature sources and the distinction between updated composition and original process inventories are limitations for plant-specific modelling. Modellers could parameterise nutrient-recycling or waste-treatment simulations using platform-openlca. data-ecoinvent-life-cycle-inventory-database is a related background source with separate access requirements. The two addresses are consolidated into one review record. No workbook or document tables were downloaded, and no nutrient balance was recalculated.
